preconditions.description: n and k are positive integers with k less than n.

postconditions.description: The permutation p has length n.

postconditions.expression: all(p[i] != p[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n))
postconditions.description: All elements in p are distinct.

postconditions.expression: len(set(abs(p[i] - p[i+1]) for i in range(n-1))) == k
postconditions.description: The group of numbers |p_1 - p_2|, |p_2 - p_3|, ..., |p_{n-1} - p_{n}| has exactly k distinct elements.
